description.html: The Atman Champion CX-0078 is a diaphragm air pump with a single outlet. On the packaging, the manufacturer describes it as extremely quiet, with low energy use and high airflow. It is intended for smaller aquariums, where it runs one air stone or one sponge filter. The pump connects with airline tubing, and the airflow also depends on water depth and the resistance of the air stone.

An air pump pushes air through tubing to an air stone or sponge filter. The bubbles move the water surface, where gas exchange takes place, so the water gets more oxygen. This matters most in summer, when warm water holds less oxygen, in heavily stocked aquariums and while treating fish.

Place the pump above the water level or fit a check valve on the tubing, so water cannot flow back into the pump during a power cut. Set it on a soft surface so vibrations do not carry into the furniture. To connect it you need airline tubing and an air stone, which we also stock.
